questions.executed_sql: WITH q AS (SELECT CAST(DATE_TRUNC('QUARTER', invoice_date) AS DATE) AS quarter_start, SUM(net_revenue) AS rev FROM analytics.sales_lines WHERE invoice_date >= CAST('2025-10-01' AS DATE) AND invoice_date <= CAST('2026-09-30' AS DATE) GROUP BY 1) SELECT quarter_start, 'Q' || CAST(EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM quarter_start) AS INT) || ' ' || CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM quarter_start) AS INT) AS quarter, ROUND(rev, 2) AS net_revenue, ROUND(LAG(rev) OVER (ORDER BY quarter_start), 2) AS previous_quarter_net_revenue, ROUND((rev / NULLIF(LAG(rev) OVER (ORDER BY quarter_start), 0) - 1) * 100, 2) AS growth_pct FROM q ORDER BY quarter_start
